svg.title: Framing, encoding, semantics - and the peer you did not upgrade
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Framing, encoding, semantics - and the peer you did not upgrade” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch dividing a protocol into three separated bands labelled framing, encoding and semantics, each with the single question it answers; the same message drawn to scale as bars of 113.8 bytes of JSON, 81.1 bytes of MessagePack and 47.8 bytes of Protobuf with measured decode times of 4.44, 1.19 and 1.84 microseconds beneath; a compatibility panel where an old v1 client silently ignores a new currency field but a renamed field is crossed out in red; and a reconnect timeline with retries at one, two, four and eight seconds plus jitter, above a struck-through row of evenly spaced retries labelled thundering herd.
svg.text: Framing, encoding, semantics - and the peer you did not upgrade
draw it from memory, then compare
